maria.chen: Heads up — support ticket: service account SSO failing. JIT created the user but roles didn't get assigned and there's no provision/audit event in our logs. Anyone seen SAML attribute truncation cause this?

devon: Which attribute is missing in the assertion? can you paste the decoded SAML (remove secrets) or the attribute statement?

maria.chen: pasted the relevant part from the assertion we captured: ```<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="email">
    <saml:AttributeValue>svc-backup-verylongname-that-looks-truncated@acme.example.com</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>```

ash: interesting — the acct created in our DB is `svc-backup-verylo` (Okta appears to have truncated localpart at 16 chars before the @). because our role mapping rule expects full email `service-accounts/*@acme.example.com` it fell back to `guest` default.

maria.chen: correct — ticket shows user gets `guest` and can't access dedicated pools. also noticed our audit index has no provisioning event for that user. KMS logs show normal key fetches later, but nothing for the JIT provision call.

sec-bot: Alert: detected missing provisioning audit events for SSO path since 1800400000. Ticket created: SEC-4821. (assigning to eng-security). :rotating_light:

devon: quick check: did we recently switch audit API for provisioning? last deploy replaced the old /audit/provision -> /events/v2 and IIRC the JIT path calls the old client in one code path. If so the event could be swallowed.

ash: yep, the JIT handler was missed in the audit client refactor. PR landed but this endpoint excluded by a conditional. I'll open a hotfix PR to ensure provisioning emits to events/v2.

ops_oncall: short-term mitigation: Okta transform rule is truncating attributes >16. we can update the transform to output `uid` + `@acme.example.com` where uid is the full value (Okta supports `String.replace` and `substring` but that won't help if real data >16). Okta support says the attribute store has a 64 char limit for some derived attributes.

devon: proposed long-term fix: update role-mapping to use `okta:uid` instead of full email, and normalize both sides. but that's a bigger RBAC migration. For now we should: 1) hotfix audit event emission, 2) rollback the Okta transform that started truncating, 3) run a one-off re-provision for affected service accounts.

maria.chen: +1. I can run a script to re-run JIT on the affected list once Okta change is live. note: re-provisioning will create new users if email mismatch. we need to merge/trust the truncated-to-full mapping. Prefer a script that maps existing truncated users back to full email using assertion capture.

okta-integration-bot: Okta ticket OKTA-99817 created referencing attribute truncation. Support responded: "We see attribute in transform longer than 32 will be truncated when using expression language with `left()`". Suggested workaround: use `replaceAll()` to create a shorter stable uid or send a separate attribute `okta_uid` that preserves full string.

ash: action items I created: SEC-4821 (audit hotfix), ENG-6712 (okta transform rollback), ENG-6713 (reprovision script + dry-run), ENG-6714 (role-mapping migration design). I'll link PRs.

devon: FYI we should also add an integration test that asserts that SAML attr length >64 still maps correctly (simulate long service account names).

ops_oncall: scheduling a CAB for emergency deploy window tomorrow 04:00 UTC. tagging infra and devex. :calendar:

maria.chen: thanks all. I'll notify the affected customers and keep them updated in the ticket. will paste repro steps once I have the re-provision dry-run results.
